newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada 91-day T-bill yields avg 2.943 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada 91-day T-bill yields avg 2.943 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Canada said the average yield at this week's auction of C$3.2 billion of 91-day Government of Canada treasury bills due June 5 was 2.943 percent, up from 2.858 percent last week.

The average yield on C$1.3 billion of 175-day T-bills due August 28, 1997 was 3.245 percent, up from 3.098 percent last week, and on C$1.2 billion of 364-day T-bills due March 5, 1998 was 3.649 percent, up from 3.467 percent.
The Bank bought C$525 million three-month, C$125 million six-month and C$100 million one-year bills. It holds C$1.0 billion of C$5.8 billion of bills maturing March 13.
For details of the latest week's T-bill auction, see BOCWATYQ ENTER. For details of next week's T-bill tender, see BOCWATYM ENTER.
